node.label: Manipur & Northeast
node.summary: Ethnic conflict and security in Manipur and the Northeast.

facts.text: **Committee on Tribal Unity (CoTU)**, a Kuki-Zomi body, called a 48-hour shutdown in Manipur's **Kangpokpi** district over the alleged abduction of two Kuki youth.
